sources.notes: Highest-priority independent expert family. Preserve Warren Sharp/Sharp-family correlation. Public material can be sourced directly; premium book/package material is incorporated only if legitimately accessible or user-uploaded.
Track analyst attribution, but count correlated Action content as one source family for consensus unless there is clearly independent underlying work.
Use football-relevant personnel/usage evidence; do not convert fantasy-oriented opinions into side/total signals without independent betting relevance.
Factual-information family, not handicapping consensus. Prioritize official injury reports, inactives, transactions and authoritative team statements.
Curate team-specific authoritative reporters. Treat as information evidence rather than expert betting votes unless an item is explicitly analytical.

correlationRule: Multiple articles, podcast appearances, analysts or derivative pieces expressing the same underlying thesis from one source family count as one correlated family signal for convergence scoring. Preserve analyst-level detail separately.
paywallRule: Do not infer or fabricate inaccessible premium analysis. Premium content is eligible when legitimately accessible to the assistant or supplied/uploaded by the user.
